Gate 9/10, coins 4: Mason -> gate 10 (not 12), coins 0. Gate 8, coins 3: Mason -> unchanged. Gate 10/10, coins 5: Mason -> unchanged coins 5, gate 10.

Wave 3: walkers enter at 1325+72k (6), then runners at 1757, 1829, 1901, 1973 (4, 1.2 s apart); runner health 1, x -0.05/tick (3/s); a runner kill took score 195->210 (+15) and coins +1.

Full seed-1 run (judge-planned 8-wave script, normal): tick 6578 screen won, score 1540 = 1340 enemy points (46x10 + 32x15 + 10x40) + 20x10 gate; at hard 1480 = 1340 + 20x7; enter on won -> title.
Escape at 200: paused, enemies/bolts identical at 201, 250, 300; Resume (enter) -> play continues from those positions (walker 15.025 -> 15.0 at 301); escape, down, enter (Title) -> title screen.
Shop opened -> saved true (kept.save written in settings.json); next run with that folder: title texts [.., Start, Continue, Settings, Quit] (Continuar / Continuer in es/fr).

Bought Quick (coins 5->0) in wave-1 shop, played on, paused, Title. Next run: Continue -> shop, wave 1, score 50, coins 0, gate 10, quick 1, heavy 0; Next wave -> 'Wave 2 of 8', first walker 60 ticks later.

Start with a save -> saved false, next run title has no Continue; won and lost runs end with saved false and no Continue; Title from pause after the shop left saved true and Continue shown, resuming at the last shop.

Win 1540 -> won/title show 'Best: 1,540', also in a later run; later lost run with 50 kept Best 1,540; fresh folder lost 50 -> 'Mejor: 50' on lost screen and next title. Won and lost screens show best.
Seed 7, same script, two identical copies of a kept folder: outputs byte-identical (same md5). Wave-1 lanes seed 1 [2,2,6,10,6], seed 2 [8,2,6,4,6], seed 3 [10,4,8,2,8].

Wave-8 frame at tick 6400: gray gate at left, blue guard at (2,2), green walkers, small yellow runners, large red brutes and white bolts all at the pixel spots the state's x/y give; HUD shows Score 1,020, Coins 56, Wave 8 of 8, Gate 7.
Frames: French title with Reglages marked by a focus ring, Spanish settings with Idioma: Espanol marked, English shop with Heavy bolts marked; menus drawn in the chosen language.
assets/strings/en.json, es.json, fr.json, one table per language, UI uses @keys; README 'Add a language' explains copying en.json.
README has how to play, where kept (FOLDER/settings.json: volume, language, difficulty, kept.best, kept.save), and play/frame commands that I ran as written and that worked.

defects: Shop shows Mason as '10/10: done' with no price whenever the gate is at full health, though the brief asks for each thing with its price (Mason can be bought any number of times).
Start (title) and Next wave (shop) are always drawn as bright blue filled buttons, so the focused entry is marked only by a thin outline and can be mistaken for the unfocused primary button.
Bolts in flight are removed when the shop opens (README says so); the brief does not ask for this, but it is harmless.

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
